ipopt_tolerance_diagnostic.interpretation: The original Ipopt discrepancy disappears under a tighter tolerance and larger iteration budget on the same matched-start snapshot. This identifies termination tolerance/budget sensitivity as the current explanation to test, not a policy or solver superiority result.

interpretation: Both solvers reached locally solved endpoints and passed individual physical endpoint acceptance. The initial five-iteration Ipopt run at tolerance 1e-8 failed the cross-policy covariance gate (maximum residual difference 0.0028511005), while MadNLP passed it. A repeat Ipopt run on the same snapshot with tolerance 1e-10 and max_iter 10 passed every endpoint and cross-policy gate, reducing the maximum residual difference to 3.30e-12. The evidence is therefore termination-tolerance/budget sensitive and remains descriptive; it does not rank classic, SI, local MV/LV, or either solver.
next_gate: repeat the qualified Ipopt protocol on a second LV feeder or a predeclared perturbed-start matrix before interpreting scaling policy effects
